privacy.clearMessage: This deletes saved conversations, summaries, memory and style. Messages in Messenger, WhatsApp and Instagram stay. The next sync may download the conversations again.
privacy.onDeviceBody: Cue saves downloaded messages and key details. Your style traits and frequent phrases are computed on the phone.
privacy.aiData: With AI on, up to the last 80 messages, sender names, the draft and the selected chat's memory are sent to DeepSeek via Supabase.
privacy.aiUpdates: Memory and reminders update automatically after new sent and received messages, following a short pause in typing. Automatic memory covers synced conversations except those where you disable AI in the profile. Disabling AI does not withdraw data already sent to the provider. You always review and send replies yourself.
privacy.managementFooter: Deleting Cue data doesn't delete messages from your messengers. Syncing may download them again.
privacy.deleted: Data saved in Cue has been deleted.
